rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.requirement: It is illegal for anyone to sell or license an algorithmic rent-pricing device to a landlord in San Diego, and it is illegal for a landlord to use such a device to set rental rates or occupancy levels.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation
rules.exemptions: Does not include software publishing reports from aggregated historical nonpublic data more than 90 days old or public information that does not recommend future rates; software used to set rates under affordable housing program guidelines; or software used in appraisals that does not recommend rates during runtime.
rules.penalty: Civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus injunctive relief, damages, and attorney's fees/costs to prevailing party; each month of continued use and each property constitutes a separate violation.
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. (b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
